title: Reduction from an NP language to SAT
statement: Let $L$ be a language over the Boolean alphabet. If $L$ belongs to $\mathrm{NP}$, then $L$ has a polynomial-time many-one reduction to $\mathrm{SAT}$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language over the Boolean alphabet
replaced: For every language $L$ in $\mathrm{NP}$, the map sending an instance $x$ to the serialization of its Cook--Levin tableau at the producer horizon is a polynomial-time many-one reduction from $L$ to $\mathrm{SAT}$; neither the certificate parameters nor any public statement is modified.
